annotations.title: List the photos of a hire

description:
List a hired worker’s bounty photos in the order sent. Continue until there is no nextCursor.
Use for: looking through the photos before you pick them with pick_photos.
Not for: how many photos are in each state (get_hire); downloading the picked photos (download_picked_photos).
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: list_hire_photos({"hireId":"a3Fh8kQz1WpL0mNc","filter":"to_review"})
Errors: no_submission, no_photo_submission; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page. Leave it out for the first page.

filter.description: Only photos in this state. Default: all.

hireId.description: The hire id, from list_hires or accept_application.

limit.description: Rows wanted. A page can hold fewer, or none; only a page without nextCursor is the end.

name: list_hire_photos

areaVerdict.description: Relative to the bounty’s current area: inside or outside. unknown: photo location missing; no_area: bounty has no area.

capturedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

distanceMeters.description: Whole meters from the center of the bounty’s current area. Left out when the area or photo location is missing.

title: List the photos of a hire
